name: game-save-point
description: /save writes an 8-bit save screen (cleared, quest log, decisions, inventory, a password with the resume prompt copied); /load <password>; a title screen with CONTINUE, NEW GAME and LOAD when a session starts in a folder with saves

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: off shows saves as plain text; casual and hardcore draw the save screen

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: nes, gameboy and amber are made for dark terminals; theme follows your Claude Code theme (use it on a light background)

maxAgeDays.title: Offer saves up to (days)
maxAgeDays.description: A new session offers the project's latest save when it is at most this old
